question: According to the PIB release 'Proactive Measures taken by CAQM to contain Air Pollution' (10 November 2025), farm fire incidents in Haryana between 15 September and 9 November 2025 fell by roughly what percentage compared to the same period in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**About 65%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **Press Information Bureau (PIB)** release titled 'Proactive Measures taken by CAQM to contain Air Pollution' dated **10 November 2025**, there has been a significant decline in farm fire incidents in the northern states.
 
• For the state of **Haryana**, the total number of farm fire incidents recorded between **15 September and 9 November 2025** showed a remarkable reduction of **About 65%** compared to the same period in **2024**.
 
• This data is monitored and reported by the **Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM)** using a **Standard Protocol** developed by **ISRO** to track **Active Fire Events (AFE)**.
 
• The reduction is attributed to the strict implementation of the **State Action Plan**, which involves both **In-situ** and **Ex-situ** crop residue management strategies.
 
• The decline in incidents in **Haryana** is a crucial factor in managing the **Air Quality Index (AQI)** of the **National Capital Region (NCR)**, which typically deteriorates during the onset of winter due to stubble burning.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is About 65%.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM)**:
 
 
• The **CAQM** is a **statutory body** formed under the **Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas Act, 2021**.
 
• It was established to ensure better coordination, research, identification, and resolution of problems surrounding the **air quality index** in the **NCR** and adjoining areas like **Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh**.
 
 
 
• **Stubble Burning (Parali)**:
 
 
• This practice involves setting fire to the straw stubble that remains after harvesting grains like **Paddy**.
 
• It is primarily done to quickly clear the fields for the **Rabi** crop (wheat) sowing season.
 
• Burning releases large amounts of **Carbon Monoxide (CO)**, **Methane (CH4)**, and **Particulate Matter (PM2.5 and PM10)** into the atmosphere.
 
 
 
• **Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP)**:
 
 
• **GRAP** is an emergency framework implemented by the **CAQM** to prevent further deterioration of air quality.
 
• It is divided into four stages: **Stage I - 'Poor'** (AQI 201-300), **Stage II - 'Very Poor'** (AQI 301-400), **Stage III - 'Severe'** (AQI 401-450), and **Stage IV - 'Severe Plus'** (AQI > 450).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Crop Residue Management (CRM) Scheme**:
 
 
• The **Central Government** provides funds under the **CRM scheme** to subsidize machinery like **Super Seeders**, **Happy Seeders**, and **Bio-decomposers**.
 
• Farmers receive a **50% subsidy** for individual machinery and **80% subsidy** for establishing **Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs)**.
 
 
 
• **Legal and Monitoring Actions**:
 
 
• The **Supreme Court of India** has frequently intervened to direct states to provide incentives to farmers to avoid burning.
 
• **Environmental Compensation (EC)** is imposed on farmers found violating the ban on stubble burning, with rates fixed based on the **acreage of the land**.
 
• In **2025**, the use of **remote sensing technology** and **flying squads** helped in real-time detection and prevention of fire incidents in **Haryana** and **Punjab**.
